An unnamed island in the [[Orange Islands]] appears in ''[[EP098|A Way Off Day Off]]''. It is presumably the deserted island located between [[Murcott Island]] and [[Mandarin Island South]] shown on the [[Media:Orange.jpg|map]] in ''[[Extreme Pokémon: The Guide for the Ultimate Fan]]''.

It features several small waterfalls that empty into a basin, which later flows into a running creek and eventually a crescent-shaped bay. This island is uninhabited, and is home to many different fruit trees. Many {{p|Farfetch'd}} live on this island, and it is hinted that they migrate here once a year.
